summary: Source Data now opens from its cached summary instead of re-reading the whole imported table on every load.
details: The cached table summary is shared by everyone working on a project, but two ArcRho versions used the same cache file name and each rejected the other's copy, so both kept rebuilding it. On a large imported table that turned every Source Data load into a full re-read of the file.
The cache file name now carries its format version, so different ArcRho versions keep their own copy and each one loads from cache.
Reloading the source table clears every cached summary for the project, as it did before.
